run_transfo_xl_evaluate: run the Transformer-XL evaluation script on the test split with default WikiText-103 model
test_transfo_xl_model: test the TransfoXLLMHeadModel by loading a pretrained model and evaluating on valid split
create_corpus_iterator: create a corpus iterator from TransfoXLCorpus for valid and test data splits with batch size and target length
build_transfo_xl_tokenizer: build a TransfoXLTokenizer from a pretrained model name for tokenizing the dataset
evaluate_model_loss: evaluate the model loss and perplexity on a given data iterator using the evaluate function
